inputs.label: Data (x-www-form-urlencoded)
inputs.description: Weather data received from the Ecowitt station as URL-encoded form data.

inputs.label: Temperature (1-Celcius, 0-Fahrenheit)
inputs.description: Select the temperature unit used by the station: 1 for Celsius or 0 for Fahrenheit.

inputs.label: Windspeed (1-km/h, 0-mph)
inputs.description: Select the wind speed unit used by the station: 1 for km/h or 0 for mph.

inputs.label: Pressure (1-bar, 0-hPa)
inputs.description: Select the pressure unit used by the station: 1 for bar or 0 for hPa.

inputs.label: Rainfall (1-mm, 0-inch)
inputs.description: Select the rainfall unit used by the station: 1 for millimetres or 0 for inches.

inputs.label: Vapor Pressure Deficit (2-mbar, 1-hPa, 0-kPa)
inputs.description: Select the VPD unit used by the station: 2 for mbar, 1 for hPa, or 0 for kPa.

outputs.label: PASSKEY
outputs.description: Passkey identifying the Ecowitt station or upload source.

outputs.label: Stationtype
outputs.description: Reported type of weather station.

outputs.label: Date UTC
outputs.description: Timestamp of the weather data in UTC.

outputs.label: Indoor temperature
outputs.description: Indoor temperature in the unit selected by IN02_TEMP_UNIT.

outputs.label: Indoor humidity
outputs.description: Indoor relative humidity, typically expressed as a percentage.

outputs.label: Relative pressure
outputs.description: Relative atmospheric pressure in the unit selected by IN04_PRESSURE_UNIT.

outputs.label: Absolute pressure
outputs.description: Absolute atmospheric pressure in the unit selected by IN04_PRESSURE_UNIT.

outputs.label: Temperature
outputs.description: Outdoor temperature in the unit selected by IN02_TEMP_UNIT.

outputs.label: Humidity
outputs.description: Outdoor relative humidity, typically expressed as a percentage.

outputs.label: Wind direction
outputs.description: Reported wind direction.

outputs.label: Wind speed
outputs.description: Current wind speed in the unit selected by IN03_SPEED_UNIT.

outputs.label: Wind gust
outputs.description: Current wind gust speed in the unit selected by IN03_SPEED_UNIT.

outputs.label: Max daily gust
outputs.description: Maximum wind gust recorded today in the unit selected by IN03_SPEED_UNIT.

outputs.label: Current rain rate
outputs.description: Current rainfall rate in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Event rain
outputs.description: Rainfall accumulated during the current rain event in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Hourly rain
outputs.description: Rainfall accumulated over the current hour in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Daily rain
outputs.description: Rainfall accumulated today in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Weekly rain
outputs.description: Rainfall accumulated this week in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Monthly rain
outputs.description: Rainfall accumulated this month in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Yearly rain
outputs.description: Rainfall accumulated this year in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Total rain
outputs.description: Total accumulated rainfall in the unit selected by IN05_DEPTH_UNIT.

outputs.label: Sun
outputs.description: Reported solar radiation value.

outputs.label: UV force
outputs.description: Reported ultraviolet index.

outputs.label: Vapour Pressure Deficit
outputs.description: Vapour pressure deficit in the unit selected by IN06_VPD_UNIT.

outputs.label: Battery
outputs.description: Reported battery status or level.

outputs.label: Frequency
outputs.description: Reported radio frequency or frequency band.

outputs.label: Model
outputs.description: Reported weather station model.

outputs.label: Error
outputs.description: Error information reported with the received weather data.
